newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce says unit gets Brazil order. [CORRECTED 8:24 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce says unit gets Brazil order. [CORRECTED 8:24 GMT]

text.p: Rolls-Royce plc said on Tuesday its unit Allison Engine Company had signed a $120 million contract to supply Rio-Sul Aereos Regionais S.A., Brazil's second largest regional airline, with 10 Embraer EMB-145 regional jets powered by Allison AE 3007A engines.
The contract includes options to supply five more jets and further options for an additional 15 aircraft. (Company clarifies number of options)
In a statement, Rolls-Royce said deliveries of the EMB-145 are expected to commence in the third quarter of 1997.
Rio-Sul is the fifth airline to purchase the EMB-145 but the first in South America.
"This contract opens up a very important market for the AE3007 A-powered EMB-145," said Allen S Novick, vice president of Large Commercial Engines for Allison Engine Company.
Rolls-Royce said the AE3007A is a "quiet, reliable turbofan engine that provides the new 50-passenger EMB-145 regional jet with 7,500 pounds of efficient thrust."
It is designed for the growing regional jet and medium-to-large business jet markets.
